description: This file defines API endpoints related to comments on work items within a project management system. It includes models for comment data, functions to handle listing and adding comments, and integrates with Supabase for data storage and user authentication. The code uses FastAPI for defining routes and request handling.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Represents a single comment on a work item, including metadata such as author information and timestamp.

classes.name: CreateCommentRequest
classes.description: Payload model for creating a new comment, including validation rules for the body.

methods.description: Provides a Supabase client instance configured with the application's settings.

methods.name: tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str]] _resolve_user_from_bearer_token( supabase: SupabaseClient, authorization: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Resolves a user's ID and display name from an authorization token, utilizing Supabase auth and optional database lookups.

methods.name: List[Comment] list_comments( project_id: str = Path(..., description="UUID of the project"), id: int = Path(..., description="Numeric item id within the project"), supabase: SupabaseClient = Depends(get_supabase), )
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve all comments associated with a specific work item.

methods.name: Comment add_comment( project_id: str = Path(..., description="UUID of the project"), id: int = Path(..., description="Numeric item id within the project"), payload: CreateCommentRequest = ..., supabase: SupabaseClient = Depends(get_supabase), authorization: Optional[str] = Header(default=None, alias="Authorization"), )
